nom: Drunk Elephant Laini Latherless Conditioning Co-Cleanser

avis.titre: Great for my high porosity hair!
avis.texte: Laini is making the whole diference on my high porosity hair. My scalp is clean and my hair is starting to gain life again. All the high porosity dull, dry and frizzy aspect are gone. I'm using just like a shampoo and it is doing fine.

avis.titre: Great for my high porosity hair!
avis.texte: Laini is making the whole diference on my high porosity hair. My scalp is clean and my hair is starting to gain life again. All the high porosity dull, dry and frizzy aspect are gone.

avis.titre: please make refills in a FULLY recyclable
avis.texte: container. possibly my favorite shampoo of all time—on my 2 bf bottle now— but repeatedly tossing the pump into the landfill plus a large single use plastic container has me still searching for a sustainable option.
African American, relaxed hair and I think it was perfect for my dry winter scalp!

I have naturally curly, Caucasian, thigh length hair. I have been using cowashes and cleansing conditioners for many years; this was a bust. I had one I loved, but it was discontinued so I've been looking for a suitable replacement. This isn't it. I can't stand the smell of it, I feel like it does absolutely nothing for my hair, and I wish I could return it.

I've been using this for a bit now and am always amazed at how beautiful my hair feels afterwards. I have very long, thick curly/wavy hair. I used to use the biggest blob of conditioner just to be able to finger comb the conditioner through my hair. This allows me to finger comb while I'm shampooing. My hair has never felt so clean and soft.

at first my hair was being a bit weighed down, surprising because I've got a history of co-washing. But after a couple weeks, my hair and scalp are the happiest they've ever been. Very light refreshing scent that doesn't stay on hair. I have dry hair & scalp. I do usually add a little leave-in moisture on ends but it is the only shampoo that I can go without a conditioner. I love it despite my years of trying to stop single-use plastic. It's also lasting a long time — I only wash a few times per week, but my child played with the pump and wasted at least a couple of washes' worth, so price-wise it's good bang for buck.

Deepest thanks to the maker of this luxury shampoo! ..My battle with hair care is SO lengthy.. I cannot convey the doubt I had when initially coming across this co-cleanser. We have a farm. Between the constant barn dust, Diatomaceous Earth, animal grooming, grounds mowing, gardening, cleaning the entire environments & bird enclosures MY HAIR WAS AN ABSOLUTE MESS! I have fine, long, curly/wavy 'mature' hair. I thought the only solution was the pricey hair dressers' treatments. I cannot stand waisting time at the salon (or money). THIS is a remarkable solution! I don't even use conditioner.. Just astounds me!! My hair looked and felt like a nest of hay. I was hesitant to even use the shampoo when it arrived as it reminded me of bacon grease. I couldn't fathom putting it on my head & using as a shampoo & textures are a big deal to me. I bit down and did it. I don't know what kind of research this takes but I've now been using this for months and I'M BEYOND GRATEFUL. Combs right through afterward. What a shift in my hair care. LOVE YA for this answer to my hair dilemmas!

After a couple of uses my hair is less dry and softer and my scalp no longer has any itchy spots. At first it was flattening my curls & waves, but they've bounced back after ~3 weeks of using a couple times per week. Those who are finding it no good are probably not rinsing it thoroughly enough. You do have to rinse longer and a little more vigorously than a standard foaming shampoo. I massage it in well, then the same again while rinsing. I do usually add a light amount of leave-in conditioner bar. My hair stays happy for the day or two I skip washing, but since it's completely non-drying I am washing more frequently than I had been with previous supposedly hydrating shampoos. Really the best hair cleanser I've used in my 5 decades. Using it on my kid too so he can skip the conditioner step, since his hair is not bleached like mine.

Really like this co-wash. Have been using bars for the past few years but they don't work well as co-washes as they invariably buildup. This is great and I only need a little leave-in conditioner afterwards so can skip the in-shower conditioner and no buildup so my super dry hair doesn't turn into straw sticks on days 2-3. That said, before this I had wavy outer layer and S-curly underneath which is now just overall slightly wavy. Had hoped this would help encourage the curl. Still giving it a shot to see if there's a product combo that will work. The best part of this wash was I had a super itchy spot that it reduced after first, then completely eliminated after 2 uses. That is why I'm trying to stick it out. my fine thin curly-haired sister is having the same issue with her curls being flattened.

This product is just okay, but I still like it alright. I like this product because it works well for me as a cowash AND a conditioner. I originally bought it because it was fragrance free, and I'm trying to transition most of my go-to products to fragrance free products. I mostly only use this as a conditioner now, and it does a fair job. As a 2c/3a hair person, using this as a cowash can tend to make my scalp feel a little greasy if I use it too many washes in a row. Otherwise, it's a nice cowash/conditioner combo, and the jumbo size is great value. I believe it is also curly-girl approved according to curlsbot.

This is all I use most days! I do a deep cleanse and deep conditioner about once a month. But day to day this does the job. Cleans without stripping, and conditions without weighing my hair down. This does not have any strong fragrance which I appreciate. PLEASE keep making this! After cancer treatment it seems like everything irritates my skin and scalp, except Drunk Elephant
Love it! Perfect for my fine hair. In the winter I use a little conditioner after but otherwise I find that conditioner is not needed with this product.

avis.titre: If you want the softest hair, use this!!
avis.texte: Love this shampoo. It works so good and leaves my hair so shiny

avis.titre: I'll never go back to "regular" shampoo
avis.texte: This leaves my hair shiny, clean for days, and so healthy looking.
Paradoxically dried out my curls… i tried using a conditioner following cowashing, but that did not do much to rectify how dried out my curls were.

I tried this product quite a few times. I'm familiar with co-washing as I've been doing it for years with another co-washing specific brand, but I always like to try out new things. This cleanser simply isn't moisturizing enough to use more than once in a while unless you have oily hair (I have fine, chemically processed hair that is normal to slightly dry). My hair was more moisturized when using shampoo and regular conditioner, so I finally tossed what I had left as I hated using it.

avis.titre: my hair looks dry and dull
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this. I was using another brand of co-wash that's more expensive, so I was hoping this would be as good for a lower price point. Unfortunately, it's very drying and not as moisturizing as the other brand I was using. My hair just looks dull and limp now. Super disappointed!

I found this product bored and scrolling Ulta, I wanted somthing that I could use in between washdays. I am not a dry shampoo fan at all, and I had heard of 'co-cleansers' before. I will repurchase this product over and over and over again. I have longer, thin hair. This product doesnt make my hair feel weighed down, or heavy at all. My hair is soft and tangle free, but looks like I just shampooed. It lasts me about 24 hours before my hair gets greasy again, so not a long term solution to greasy hair, but better then using dry shampoo or having to shampoo my head all the time. Smells good, great amount for the price, takes me about two pumps

I really like this product. It is definitely a more affordable co-wash compared to some others I have tried. It makes my hair feel clean and it is easy to detangle after the shower. My only issue is it is hard to disperse throughout my hair. It is almost like my hair absorbs it and I can't feel it to evenly distribute throughout my head. I feel like I end up using more because of that.

I've struggled for years to find a shampoo that didn't dry out my scalp. I have tried everything from the drug store brand to some of the priciest brands on the market. Two weeks in with this and my hair and scalp is happier and healthier than it's ever been in my life. It's simple. I don't have to use conditioner. This is will be a mainstay until I'm white and balding with age and even then I'll probably still use it to keep my scalp in line.
I've never felt my hair so soft before! This product is a game changer!!

I have very thin, fine, wavy, frizzy hair. In other words, a nightmare. I also have a very sensitive scalp that is prone to itching and even acne. I have to avoid fragrances and now it appears that I have to avoid preservatives as well and maybe the coconut-based lather that is in so many shampoos. Laini does not have any of these and does not irritate my scalp. No itching or other problems. And my hair comes out detangled and shiny, not frizzy which is amazing and much better than other conditioners I have used (I use a shower hair brush to apply). My scalp feels clean. I use a little of the Wild Marula tangle spray for second-day hair because my hair is dry. The downside is that Laini does not really have any slip, and so I use a fair amount and it is expensive. In addition, I can't just pick it up at my local Ulta, it has to be mail ordered. But the pros seem to outweigh the cons!
Such a great product. My hair combs well after and feels so light.

I bought the big bottle of the Laini Latherless, and even after using 10 pumps my hair is greasy by the middle of the day unfortunately this has been the only terrible product for me from drunk elephant and I own every single product.

avis.titre: Is a really good product to try
avis.texte: I was glad that i found this product beacuse is really good for the skyn and all types of skyn's

If your hair is perfectly detangled before every wash day, if your hair is thin, if your hair is not actual curls (3a or lower), then this could be worth a try. If you said no to any of these, it's probably not worth the try. I've also heard the company is notorious for terrible customer service. All that aside, this is a pathetic attempt at a cowash if you're using it for "all hair types" as they marketed it 🙄

avis.titre: Great for coarse and curly hair
avis.texte: Didn't expect to like it, but I love it. Works better than my prior shampoos and conditioners. I still use conditioner from chin length down and leave it in, but it isn't necessary. I do this so I don't have to use as much styling product. Just purchased my second large bottle, so it's passed the test.
I really do like this. I have thick, 2C hair and I didn‚Äôt need conditioner! It cleansed my hair super well and left it feeling soft and lathered! It doesn‚Äôt really have a scent though.

I've used latherless hair cleansers in the past but was excited to try one that is fragrance-free. (I am a huge DE fan for skincare and use it for pretty much everything.) I've given this cleanser a shot for a few weeks now. I have naturally thin hair that tends to get oily. Unfortunately, this product makes it heavy and lifeless. I guess I'll just give the remainder to a friend. I probably used two ounces, if that. It would have been nice to get it in a smaller bottle to avoid waste. Might be great for thicker and/or drier hair ‚Äî just not mine.
I think this could be great for some hair types however it left my thin blond hair darker/greasy looking and heavy.
ok - let‚Äôs be honest. no lather is tough to get used to. but, have faith! your hair will be soft, smooth, and feel so healthy. highly recommend!
Used this product twice so far in my daughter outrageously kinky curly dry hair. Her texture is becoming softer already. This blow out has last 3 weeks with no touch up!

I am an older... well, more mature woman and as such my hair has been changing recently. Naturally dry wavy blonde hair now getting a darker and just a few greys. I'm also getting sensitive skin a lot. Very rashy around my neck so I'm avoiding all the bad things including essential oils which never bothered me. I'm still working on my flakiness which is also a new thing (this getting older thing is full of suprises). This product cleanses well, encourages my natural wave by not drying it out and is very conditioning.

Used it twice and makes my 2c waves pop. Reduced frizz, doesn't weigh down my hair. No need for conditioner. I just finish with my curly leave in cream. No scalp itch. Ends are not crunchy. I bleach my hair and it is bra strap length.
I like the way my hair responds to this product but it is difficult to get use to no lather. I don't really like that part but I do like how my hair looks and feels.

I absolutely love this co cleanser! It gets my hair really clean and it doesn't weigh down my fine hair, at all. I use this in between using regular shampoo. It says to try it without conditioner but I use some because my hair is very dry, especially the ends. I gave some to my mom to try and she loved it too and bought the full size bottle. She has very, very thin hair and it makes her hair nice and fluffy. She uses a little bit on her ends as a leave in. I also love that it's a huge bottle that will last forever!

I usually prefer lathering products for washing face, body, and hair but I thought I‚Äôd give Laini Latherless a try. Leaves my hair soft and shiny. Cleans without stripping hair/scalp of oils. I alternate with DE shampoo and conditioner.

My hair gets greasy so easily that I was trying to train it to not have to be washed so much. I failed, but after Laini Latherless Conditioning Co-Cleanser, my hair is clean yet conditioned and light. It does not look greasy but it doesn't look dry. I love this. I have baby-fine hair, but a TON of it. And it's incredibly long, too. If your hair matches that profile, then definitely purchase this product.

I have pretty average irish hair. But wavy, but frizzy. Medium density, length, thickness. I get oily roots and dry ends. This works fantastically for me. I've been using it almost every time I show and then using DE's shampoo and conditioner about once a week. Been doing this instead of the more traditional wash, condition weekly deep condition. And my hair actually gets less oily and I need less leave in. You have to really work it into the hair and then rinse way more than you might a normal conditioner, but my hair gets really clean and conditioned in this one step.

I wasn‚Äôt impressed the first time I used it it left gummy stuff in my hair. However I don‚Äôt believe I rinsed it out thoroughly. The second time I used it it was absolutely perfect and my hair feels soft and silky.

Very expensive and not sure it's doing anything at all. I have newly been working out daily so having to take many more showers. Because my scalp gets sweaty I feel like I need to wash it and my hair. Just water would turn the prior days hair products into glue, I'd think. So, co wash for every other day was my idea. This isn't fun to use, it doesn't have any noticeable results. Save your money and try a different brand. Nothing special about this one.
I wash my hair a lot - probably too often. I decided to add Laini Latherless into my routine and am loving how gentle it is and how shiny it makes my hair.
My life has changed forever after using this cowash. Absolutely the best thing for my curly hair. If this comes across you, buy it. It was a sign from above

avis.titre: Not Great at Leaving Hair Clean
avis.texte: I have used this for over a month, and it doesn't get my hair clean. I use it every other shampoo and space out my shampooing to every other day, for reference. I don't have oily hair or an oily scalp. In fact my hair is quite dry, but no matter what I do (use 4 pumps or 7) my hair is still not free from oil. For reference, I have hair about 5 inches past my shoulders. It is quite gentle though, which is why I gave it an extra star. I would suggest not buying this if you do actually have oily hair or scalp. You will likely not be happy with it.
Love this product! This leaves my hair feeling clean but not stripped of it natural oils, so it‚Äôs super healthy looking. Thank you DE for making such wonderful products!!!!!

I have fine hair, but quite a bit of it. I‚Äôm generally oily at the roots and dry at the ends (my hair is quite long). I have found that more moisture when cleaning actually helps to regulate the natural oils in my scalp and keeps follicles moisturized from root to tip. I also follow with a 1 to 4 ratio of ACV to water rise once a week for really shiny strands.
My 42 year old hair is less dry and frizzy with this cleanser
After every use my fine colored hair is clean and feeling fresh without any build up or being weighed down. I also love that it's free of fragrance.

This is the best hair cleanser I‚Äôve ever used. Not greasy, cleanses, and moisturizes. Rinses squeaky clean too. My hair is so happy after I use it. And it styles perfectly as well. My hair stays clean at least 4-5 days. I HIGHLY recommend this latherless hair cleanser!!

I‚Äôm really impressed with how clean it gets my hair but found it extremely drying, even with adding conditioner. I have fine hair so thought the latherless would be better but again found this very deying

Wow I am blown away by this shampoo. I have to admit I was skeptical but all of the other Drunk Elephant products have been game chargers for me so I gave this a shot. I have very oily hair that needs daily washing. I knew I needed to wash less frequently to control my oil, but I also exercise 6 days a week so I couldn‚Äôt get out of this vicious cycle. Now I use Laini instead and it‚Äôs exactly what I needed. I can still get sweaty with my workouts and wash my hair everyday without messing up my scalp. Even though this isn‚Äôt a shampoo, my scalp feels fresh and clean after my wash. I also love that this is a one step process since it makes my hair soft without needing to be combined with a conditioner.

This totally changed my hair and the way I take care of it! I use it in-between shampoos, and it's so good for post-workout cleansing too. Not too heavy, no residue and it's super soothing on my scalp. I have fine hair but a lot of it and this works so good!

avis.titre: the best product i've ever used in my hair
avis.texte: this is my favorite and i cannot live without it. zero essential oils like other co-washes. zero lather. my hair has never looked better. i paint on my hair top to bottom and then massage in. rinse really well. It dries faster and looks smooth and shiny. my hair has become fuller and healthier looking since i've started using laini. i will never be without this product as long as i live! homerun for drunk elephant!
This is a great product. I have super fine hair and it works great between washes. The size is also a plus.

I love the the shampoo and conditioner, I have very fine wavy hair and need lightweight products, and these are perfect, but I also workout a lot, so I needed something I could use to rinse out the sweat in between washes. This cowash does the job perfectly, my hair feels soft and moisturized! Love it!

avis.titre: didn‚Äôt know I needed this, but use all the time
avis.texte: I bought this on a whim to see if it would help my hair look better on no wash days. So far, I‚Äôm loving it! I find it makes my hair look clean and soft. I was nervous putting an oil based product on my hair, as my roots can get greasy, but it hasn‚Äôt been an issue at all. Glad I tried it!
I ws actually skeptical about this product because I have thin, fine hair, but it turns out that it keeps oil away and keeps my ends from drying out!! I have ended up really loving it!

I have naturally very oily hair. I could NEVER go a day without washing ... that is until I used LAINI!! It was so cleansing and gentle on my scalp, I tried dry shampoos but they didn‚Äôt ever work. Laini cleansed my hair without stripping my hair like regular shampoo can do if you wash daily!! I highly recommend!

I love this cowash so much- I‚Äôve never really tried DE products but when they emailed me about their new cowash I was like well shhhhii I need to try this! And it leaves my hair SO soft and cleanses well! Tbh it cleanses better than any other cowash I‚Äôve ever tried and it keeps my scalp and hair moisturized. Really love it- and you get a ton! Yes it‚Äôs expensive but I only cowash once a week so it should last a long time.
This shampoo works especially well on my daughters slightly coarse hair. No conditioner needed!

avis.titre: I haven‚Äôt figured this out yet
avis.texte: I like how this feels like it cleanses and moisturizes, but it makes my thin hair hang a bit flat and heavy, like when it‚Äôs a bit oily (but it doesn‚Äôt feel oily) But maybe I‚Äôm not using it right, since I‚Äôve only gotten 5 washes in with this!

This is surprisingly a great cowash! I order it on the DE website two weeks ago, and I have been really loving it! It doesn't leave your scalp dry, but it does still clean well. I even did a hot oil treatment and then used this cowash and it cleansed my scalp well without feeling greasy from the oil and it didn't strip the oil either. It makes my hair soft. I follow with a leave in conditioner and my waves look great! Also, it's expensive but you get A LOT!!! I will definitely rebuy and I'm glad Ulta carries DE now!
This stuff is so great- it doesn‚Äôt lather but my hair still feels clean and not greasy or heavy like some co-cleansers make my hair. so great for after the gym when it‚Äôs not wash day!!

This product is perfect for those days where you need to take a shower but don‚Äôt need to wash your hair with traditional shampoo. I workout daily and sweat A LOT. So I use Laini 2-3 times per week to feel clean without stripping my hair with the shampoo process. It is non greasy, but will make your scalp feel hydrated and clean!

I can't wash my hair every day without damaging it, but this has totally changed my life. Using this in between washes makes my hair look so much more healthy, and it really cuts down on me making my hair super crunchy with dry shampoo. I would love a smaller bottle option to be able to pack on trips!
